relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of LPS has been shown to activate CGRPPBN neurons

relationships.subject: alphaCGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: αCGRP-KO mice developed an inflammation-induced anorexia that was similar to that of WT mice

relationships.subject: alphaCGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Both αCGRP-KO mice and their WT littermates reduced their saccharin solution intake after the pairing of the sweet taste with inflammation-induced malaise 2 days earlier

key_findings: alphaCGRP-KO mice show normal LPS anorexia, conditioned taste aversion, formalin pain and thermal place aversion, so alphaCGRP is dispensable for many CGRP PBN neuron-mediated danger responses.
Glutamate release by the same neurons is likely sufficient.
